announcement: v0.4.2 patch: playback continuity on resize, 60fps player transitions, format tab counter fix, AAC audio encoding, and illustrated empty states.
features: Fix: Playback no longer pauses when expanding or minimizing the player
Fix: Video tab counter no longer drops to 5 when switching to Audio tab
Fix: Audio encoding forces AAC LC in merged MP4 files to prevent silent videos
Fix: Startup white screen crash caused by duration initialization order
Fix: Ultrawide videos (e.g. 1920x788) now properly labeled as 1080p HD
Fix: Audio bitrates rounded to whole numbers (e.g. 129 kbps instead of 129.488kbps)
Perf: 60fps player transition using GPU layer promotion and cubic-bezier easing
UI: Illustrated vector empty states for Queue, Library, Formats, and Search
